company.shortDescription: Routable is a payout orchestration platform that enables companies to automate, manage, and scale payouts globally.
company.description:
Routable is a payout orchestration platform that enables companies to automate, manage, and scale payouts globally through a developer-first API, compliance infrastructure, and operational tools.

It was founded in 2017 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington.

productsAndServices.description: A service for making cross-border payments in over 140 currencies to more than 220 countries and territories within 1-3 business days.

productsAndServices.description: A system to onboard, pay, and monitor vendors and contractors while managing compliance and tax documentation.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $499,996, or 1.07% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,340,070 to $211,153,296, a 33.3x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
